title: shotframe config
description: Config for shotframe, which frames raw simulator captures as App Store screenshots. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

device.description: Canvas size in CSS points plus a scale factor. width × scale by height × scale is the pixel size that comes out, so a preset is chosen to land exactly on a store size with nothing resampled.

enumDescriptions: 1320 × 2868 — the size App Store Connect requires for iPhone

sources.description: Folder of raw captures, relative to this file.

out.description: Where the framed screenshots are written, relative to this file. For fastlane deliver, use fastlane/screenshots/<locale>.

chromePath.description: A Chromium to render with, if the usual places are wrong. SHOTFRAME_CHROME does the same thing.

theme.description: The half that should come from the app's own design tokens. A listing that invents its own palette stops looking like the app it is selling.

background.description: Any CSS background value, so a stack of gradients is fine.

display.description: CSS font-family list for the heading.

text.description: CSS font-family list for the eyebrow and body.

bezel.description: The device frame, in page points. The phone is sized off whatever height the copy leaves, so these describe how it looks at the size it actually renders rather than a scale drawing of a real handset.

pad.description: Thickness of the bezel around the capture.

screenRadius.description: Corner radius of the capture inside it.

background.description: CSS background for the bezel itself.

shadow.description: CSS box-shadow, which is also where the hairline highlight lives.

gap.description: Space between eyebrow, heading and body.

stageGap.description: Space between the copy and the phone.

reservedLines.description: Lines of space held for the heading and for the body whether they use them or not. This is what keeps the phone at the same height across the set; copy that needs more fails the build.

css.description: Appended after everything else, for the one thing the config didn't foresee.

panels.description: The screenshots, in upload order. Order matters twice over: the store shows the first few in search results, and fastlane deliver uploads in filename order — which is why slugs are usually numbered.

source.description: The raw capture, a file inside `sources`.

eyebrow.description: Small caps line above the heading. Optional, but give every panel one or none.

heading.description: Keep it under about 40 characters — two lines is all that fits.

body.description: Keep it under about 110 characters. Optional, but give every panel one or none.
